name: Madmannah
overview: Madmannah is a male figure from the tribe of Judah, identified in Scripture as the son of Shaaph. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, with no additional notes expanding on his life or role. This minimal information places him within the broader context of Judah's lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Madmannah is a proper name that means 'dung place.' This meaning is recorded in the Hebrew text and does not appear to have been given by God. The name's significance is limited to its literal meaning as presented in the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Madmannah as the son of Shaaph, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text. Therefore, his known family ties are confined to this single relationship.
scriptureSignificance: Madmannah's significance lies in his place within the genealogical records of Judah, as noted in 1 Chronicles 2:49. While the biblical narrative does not elaborate on his personal story or deeds, his inclusion helps trace the lineage and heritage of the tribe of Judah, which is central to God's redemptive plan through Christ. His mention underscores the faithfulness of Scripture in preserving even lesser-known descendants in the biblical record.
